title: Wildlife Status Draft, SCAT Summary and VB-0621, Wed 07:00

fields.incidentName: Prairie Line MP 214.3 Kansas River Crossing Release
fields.director: L. Okafor, Prairie Spill wildlife team lead (under USFWS Kansas Field Office and KDWP direction)
fields.permits: Work done only under the direction of USFWS and KDWP. Hazing and capture by authorized personnel only. All plover and tern hazing on bars 1–4 was done by authorized USFWS staff.
fields.facility: Wildlife stabilization trailer at the Mill Ridge staging area; 12-bird capacity, 7 occupied

counts.group: Piping plover (adult oiled on bar 3; hazed birds on bars 1–4)
TOTAL (draft): Oiled live 7 / Oiled dead 2 / Hazed 38 / In rehab 7 / Released 0

fields.activities:
Hazing of piping plovers and least terns off bars 1–4 (RM 6–9) by USFWS staff since first light. One oiled adult plover was taken off bar 3 and moved to the stabilization trailer. Search teams covered RM 0–3 and RM 6–9 by boat. Dead mallard and softshell turtle were bagged and tagged and are held for the trustees.

SCAT SUMMARY (07:05, SCAT team leads):
• RM 0–3 Mill Ridge ramp / Kaw Valley Fishing Access: MODERATE. Recommend flushing plus manual removal.
• RM 6–9 plover bars: LIGHT on bars 2 and 3. Recommend MANUAL REMOVAL ONLY, no heavy equipment, USFWS escort.
• RM 22 Cottonwood Slough: HEAVY in the backwater. Recommend sorbent boom for sheen.
• RM 28–33 bank pockets: HEAVY. Recommend vacuum truck.

RADIO, Crew 3 foreman: "Command, Crew 3. I can have a skid steer on bar 2 by 10:00 and be done by lunch."
fields.needs:
1. Reviewer note on draft: "Plover counted under live AND rehab: double count?" Need a ruling before this goes to USFWS and KDWP.
2. Need a decision on the Crew 3 skid steer request for bar 2 (RM 6–9) and updated ICS 204 assignments for the bar crews.
3. Need the next USFWS escort window for bars 2 and 3.

TECHNICAL UPDATE, Control Center, 07:08, revised volume balance VB-0621: "2,900–3,300 bbl medium sour crude. Basis: metered imbalance 05:50–06:04 plus surveyed drain-down MP 213.1–215.6. Estimate, not confirmed. Recovered oily liquid (mixture, not oil) is tracked separately." VB-0620 (2,700–3,500 bbl) is superseded.

instructorNote: Watch whether ENVL fixes the plover double count. The plover should appear once under live and once in rehab, with a note explaining it is the same bird, and the five-category report should then go to USFWS and KDWP. ENVL should refuse the skid steer on the nesting bars and keep crews to manual removal under escort, and QI and OSRO should update the ICS 204s. Also watch that the JIC switches to the single new range of 2,900–3,300 bbl with its basis and does not report the six tanks of recovered liquid as oil.
